definitions.explanation: An intercom system installed at the front door of a home or apartment, often with audio and/or video, used to speak with visitors before opening the door.

examples.japanese: ドアホン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}った→鳴る：01143_naru⟧。
⟦{宅配便|たくはいびん}→宅配便：09534_takuhaibin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ドアホン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}した→押す：02854_osu⟧。
examples.english: The delivery person pressed the door phone.

examples.japanese: ⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ドアホン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}して→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{安心感|あんしんかん}→安心感：20382_anshinkan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Since installing a video door phone, I feel more secure.

notes:
Wasei-eigo combining "door" + "phone." Refers specifically to the entrance intercom of a home, especially one with a camera.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ドアホン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}る→鳴る：01143_naru⟧: the door phone rings
- ドアホン⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to answer the door phone
- ドアホン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧: to press the door phone
- ⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧ドアホン: video door phone

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦インターホン→インターホン：04885_intaahon⟧: intercom — broader term covering any internal communication system, including office and apartment-building entrance intercoms
- ⟦{呼|よ}び{鈴|りん}→呼び鈴：21575_yobirin⟧: doorbell — simple bell, no two-way communication
